Title: Why Mints and Mouthwash Don't Fix Bad Breath

Description:
Bad breath, if mints and mouthwash never last long, stop guessing what's causing it. Gum disease, dry mouth from medication, and postnasal drip are three common causes that mints and mouthwash can't fix.

Each one has a real fix once you know where it's actually coming from.

Watch to find out why, and what to do instead.
